user.title: Skydark Family Calendar

sync.title: Calendar sync
sync.description: Connect Google, Outlook, CalDAV, or Local Calendar in Home Assistant first. Then choose what SkyDark should import and what it should send out. You can change this later in the Skydark Settings panel.

data.import_existing: Import all existing events from the selected calendars now

data_description.pull_calendars: Events on these calendars appear in SkyDark. Leave empty to skip import.
data_description.push_calendars: New SkyDark events are created on these calendars. Leave empty to keep events only in SkyDark.
data_description.import_existing: If enabled, SkyDark copies the current calendar history (about two years back and forward) on first sync.
